title: Inputs
info:
The most basic physical control is a rotary encoder.  All functions can be accomplished with just one encoder.
Buttons may also be used. Touch is swipe and tap motions only.

Regarding Deep Sleep: Wake is only possible on RTC-capable pins.
ESP32 RTC GPIOs: 0, 2, 4, 12-15, 25-27, 32-39 / ESP32-S3/C3 RTC GPIOs: 0-21.
Inputs assigned to these pins will automatically be used for Wake.
This includes TS_INT, ENC_CLK, ENC_DT, ENC_SW, and all BTN_.

name: Rotary Encoder
info:
If the encoder works in the opposite expected direction, swap CLK and DT

name: SD Offline Mode Button
info:
SD Offline Mode is normally activated by holding any defined Button or Rotary Encoder Switch at boot.
Use this if your build does not include these or if using all 3 interferes with boot.
If this is defined, only 1 button can be used to boot this mode.
Use 255 to deactivate this boot method completely.
If no SD Card is defined, this mode is not available.

defines.comment: button used to activate SD Offline Mode

name: Disable Deep Sleep
info:
Deep sleep will be automatically enabled or disabled according to the GPIOs used for inputs.
This disables it regardless.
